adaptive_model_selection.price_interpretation: Medium effort changes reasoning configuration, not the frozen per-token sol API unit rates. This run did not test cheaper-model backend implementation. Bugs and fixes cannot be attributed to cheap models.

adaptive_known_subset_cost_composition.interpretation: All observed actors used the same model/API rates; medium effort is not a cheaper unit price. Even eliminating the helper cost would remove only its 7.37% observed share before any changed quality/retry behavior. Audits are necessary assurance work, not free overhead.
